items.summary: Supported CC 210: Fundamental Computer Programming and CC 710: Computing for Educators, teaching Java and Python to university students and K-12 educators. Developed and migrated course materials to Canvas, led help sessions, and evaluated assignments and exams.

Designed a SQL database and migrated university student records. Applied statistical analysis to evaluate rural student performance in computer science and produced visual reports for department decision-making. Built an application that extracts ACM/IEEE curriculum data and generates JSON for a departmental course-mapping tool.

items.progression: Assistant Software Engineer → Software Engineer, Digital Cadre · Promoted in 3 months
items.summary: Delivered AEM-based enterprise web features across the full software-development lifecycle. Built personalized-content, secure-document, and web-table-automation components; integrated Okta authentication at enterprise scale; and developed Java Sling models for REST integrations. Resolved critical Java and UI defects while shipping concurrent modules that improved application performance, engagement, and client KPI delivery.

Completed intensive software-development-lifecycle training and built full-stack web applications from the ground up. Applied Java Servlets, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to translate requirements into working, end-to-end web experiences.

Programmed Arduino microcontrollers in C and helped develop prototypes, including a solar-tracking system designed to maximize photovoltaic power generation. Worked with an international team to gather client requirements, demonstrate solutions, and iterate on product concepts.
